rules.title: RSO annual allowable rent increase for July 1, 2025 – June 30, 2026
rules.requirement: For rental units subject to the Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance, the annual allowable rent increase is 3% for the period July 1, 2025 through June 30, 2026.
rules.quoted_span:
Annual rent increases for rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO), effective
July 1, 2025, through June 30, 2026
is
3%
.

coverage.notes: Applies only to rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles RSO; non-RSO properties should contact the Housing Department.

rules.coverage_text: Rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO).

rules.title: RSO: no additional percentage increase for utilities
rules.requirement: Beginning February 2, 2026, landlords of RSO units may no longer add any additional percentage rent increase for utilities on top of the annual allowable increase.
rules.quoted_span: Beginning February 2, 2026, a landlord can no longer include any additional percentage increase for utilities.

coverage.notes: Applies to rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles RSO.

rules.coverage_text: Rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO).

tool_input.notes: LAHD page. I left out the state 30-day notice requirement because it is a notice rule, not a cap, and the page doesn't name the law. I also left out the SCEP/RSO fee pass-throughs ($2.83 and $1.61 per month) because they are allowed fee surcharges, not limits on rent increases.
